description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dragoon Pride Mode I (Kain - Lightning)] and [Dragoon Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Dragoon Pride Mode I (Kain - Lightning)
description.text: Dragoon abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dragoon abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Dragoon abilities after using 1/2/3+ Dragoon abilities, casts Dual Dragoon Dive after casting three Dragoon abilities
